projectDescription: Go library for detecting and expanding the user's home directory without cgo
keyFeatures: Cross-platform home directory detection (Windows, Unix, macOS, Plan 9)
No cgo dependency for cross-compilation support
Simple path expansion with tilde (~) support
publicApiSurface: Dir() - Returns the home directory for the executing user
Expand(path) - Expands ~ in a path to the home directory
Reset() - Clears the home directory cache
DisableCache - Variable to disable caching globally
